rows.commentary: 0.1: Chinelle Henry steams in and angles it across Mupachikwa, who pushes defensively right back to the bowler.
0.2: Henry persists on that testing length, beating Mupachikwa once more as the ball whisks past the outside edge.
0.3: Mupachikwa finally finds some room, working Henry neatly through the leg side to scamper back for an energetic couple.
0.4: Henry digs it in short, and Mupachikwa quickly adjusts to pull it down to deep square for a single.
0.5: Chinelle Henry steams in, angling one in to Mayers who defends it solidly back down the pitch for no run.
0.6: Chinelle Henry finishes the over with another sharp delivery, met firmly by Mayers with no run resulting.
1.1: Shawnisha Hector starts the attack, angling it in sharply to Mupachikwa who defends solidly into the off side.
1.2: Shawnisha Hector oversteps the mark, conceding a no ball that allows Mupachikwa to scamper through for two runs.
1.2: Shawnisha Hector hits her length perfectly, leaving Mupachikwa to defend the delivery with no run taken.
1.3: Shawnisha Hector maintains the pressure, pinning Mupachikwa deep in her crease with another dot ball.
1.4: Shawnisha Hector keeps it tight, forcing Mupachikwa to push firmly straight to the fielder.
1.5: Shawnisha Hector drifts onto the bat, and Mupachikwa dispatches it to the fence for a crisp boundary.
1.6: Shawnisha Hector drifts this one well outside the tramline, and the umpire stretches the arms wide to signal extra runs.
1.6: Shawnisha Hector delivers, and Mupachikwa nudges it away to scamper through for a single.
2.1: Chinelle Henry steams in and starts the over with a sharp delivery, defended solidly into the off side by Mupachikwa for no run.
2.2: Chinelle Henry keeps the pressure on with another tight length ball, successfully blocked by Mupachikwa right back down the pitch.
2.3: Chinelle Henry pushes this one through, and Mupachikwa finally breaks the shackles, nurdling it away into the gap to scamper through for a single.
2.4: Chinelle Henry hits the length hard, pinning Mayers back into the crease for a watchful dot ball.
2.5: Chinelle Henry angles this one across Mayers, who can only push it defensively into the off side.
2.6: Chinelle Henry strikes as Mayers miscues, offering a simple catch to Afy Fletcher to depart for 0.
3.1: Shawnisha Hector starts the over sharp and straight, testing Mupachikwa who defends solidly into the pitch.
3.2: Shawnisha Hector keeps it full and tight, leaving Mupachikwa no room to break the shackles.
3.3: Shawnisha Hector drifts slightly too wide, and Mupachikwa punches it away with authority for a crisp boundary.
3.4: Shawnisha Hector responds with good pace, beating Mupachikwa as the ball zips through to the keeper.
3.2: Shawnisha Hector steams in and fires it down to Mupachikwa, who works it away neatly for a single.
3.3: Shawnisha Hector pitches it up, and Kelis Ndhlovu drives it cleanly away to the boundary for four.
3.4: Shawnisha Hector adjusts her length sharply, beating Kelis Ndhlovu with extra zip.
3.5: Shawnisha Hector delivers on a good length, allowing Kelis Ndhlovu to push it into the gap for a single.
3.6: Shawnisha Hector finishes the over strongly, beating Mupachikwa with a well-directed delivery.
4.1: Chinelle Henry steams in and traps Kelis Ndhlovu in defense with a probing delivery.
4.2: Chinelle Henry maintains the pressure, pinning Kelis Ndhlovu down with another dot ball.
4.3: Chinelle Henry targets the stumps once more, and Kelis Ndhlovu can find no way through the field.
4.4: Chinelle Henry fires it in full, and Kelis Ndhlovu can only steer it straight to the fielder, scoreless.
4.5: Chinelle Henry drops it short, allowing Kelis Ndhlovu to punch it away into the leg side for a sharp single.
4.6: Chinelle Henry strains at the crease, hurls it wide, and the umpire stretches the arms to signal an extra.
4.6: Chinelle Henry sends it down to Mupachikwa, who clips it away cleanly into the gap for a single.
5.1: Karishma Ramharack starts the new over darting it in, and Mupachikwa defends watchfully back to the pitch for no run.
5.2: Karishma Ramharack keeps it tight on a length, smothered solidly by Mupachikwa with zero room for a run.
5.3: Karishma Ramharack spins one past the bat, leaving Mupachikwa to push firmly into the infield for dot ball number three.
5.4: Karishma Ramharack drops it in, and Mupachikwa nudges it away for a single.
5.5: Karishma Ramharack offers width, and Kelis Ndhlovu dispatches it to the boundary for four.
5.6: Karishma Ramharack drags her length back to beat Kelis Ndhlovu completely with a dot ball.
6.1: Afy Fletcher floats it up to Mupachikwa, who defends solidly for no run.
6.2: Afy Fletcher keeps it tight as Mupachikwa pushes firmly into the infield without scoring.
6.3: Afy Fletcher attacks the stumps, forcing Mupachikwa to block it right back down the pitch.
6.4: Afy Fletcher bowls fuller and Mupachikwa scampers through for a brisk single.
6.5: Afy Fletcher flights this one on, allowing Kelis Ndhlovu to rotate the strike with a single.
6.6: Afy Fletcher finishes the over strong, beating Mupachikwa to leave a dot.
